auth_scheme: Bearer (RUBRIK_API_KEY); webhook base URL is operator-supplied (NO default)
install_tell: Rubrik guardrail hook is webhook-style: post-completion tool blocking at /v1/after_completion/openai/v1, batch logging at /v1/litellm/batch. Source proxies inbound headers (Authorization, Cookie, x-api-key) through to the webhook -- documented behavior. LiteLLM-side integration lives at litellm/integrations/rubrik.py, not under guardrail_hooks/rubrik/ (hook dir is just an initializer stub).
misconfig_patterns: Inbound headers PROXIED to Rubrik webhook: Authorization, Cookie, x-api-key from the original client-to-LiteLLM call are forwarded. This is documented in the source. Operator-side awareness gap: customer tokens flow to Rubrik logging plane.
Webhook URL is operator-supplied; no default -- typo or DNS hijack on the operator's chosen RUBRIK_WEBHOOK_URL exfiltrates every agent call including proxied auth headers.
Anthropic /v1/messages requests get a separate logging request ID so endpoints share a trace -- correlation surface.

active_probe.notes: Operator-supplied webhook; cert-pivot on rubrik.com is the discovery move

deployment_tells: Rubrik AI Detection is part of Rubrik Security Cloud (RSC); webhook lives on customer-tenant subdomain of rubrik.com
Hook directory under guardrail_hooks/ only ships __init__.py; real implementation at litellm/integrations/rubrik.py (605 lines)
Webhook receives forwarded inbound headers -- explicit data-flow that operator must understand
